configure_ac_load_limits.title: Configure AC Load Limits
configure_ac_load_limits.description: Select the AC power sensor and set load thresholds.

data_description.ac_load_limit_w: Current maximum AC load (W). It can also be changed at runtime with the Power Load Limit entity, e.g. from an automation.
data_description.ac_overload_recovery_seconds: After the load drops below the yellow threshold minus the margin, how long it must stay there before the green zone (and turning devices on) starts
data_description.ac_zone_hysteresis_percent: A zone goes down only when the load is this much below its threshold; up is at once
data_description.ac_power_tolerance_seconds: How long the zone stays as it was when the power sensor gives no data; then the zone is “no data”
